notes: Median 95% CL upper bound on ALP-photon coupling from polarization angle oscillation of Tau A (Crab Nebula), POLARBEAR 150 GHz data 2015-2016. Data points computed from the paper's smoothed analytic bound Eq. (47): g_agamma <= 2.16e-12 GeV^-1 * (m_a/1e-21 eV) * [sinc(m_a/3.7e-19 eV)]^-1 (unnormalized sinc = sin(x)/x), valid for 9.9e-23 eV <= m_a <= 7.7e-19 eV. Assumes ALP is all of local DM with rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. A 2.5-sigma (global) hint of oscillation at 1/61 and 1/52 day^-1 is reported but not claimed as a detection.
